freeze_blockers: Qualify exact sources, rights, anchors, complete independent family and manuscript reference denominators, with grouped partitions and ethics determination where applicable.
Lock stage-specific rubric, adjudicators, sample precision, thresholds, review budget and adoption/harm limits before independent evaluation.
Pin model, licence, runtime, tokenizer, grammar, solver, reader and exact code/asset receipts; no remote code or unreviewed external inference.
Verify deterministic conservation, applicability and complete candidate pools; preserve historical development and negative runs separately.
Record owner-approved versioned design freeze and permitted dissemination before confirmatory execution.

claims.text: A specialist neural and deterministic pipeline improves reporting-standard fidelity and evidence assessment per unit resource and review effort.
limitations: Hypothesis only; no independent source or model qualification from historical synthetic and editorial seed development.
Software validity does not establish source rights, scientific validity or methodological appropriateness.
